description: Screen 6 - Trust Score Details. Rebuild app/trust-score into a detailed breakdown of the household Trust Score: a large animated ring at 87/100 with colored category segments, a five-category breakdown with notes, a 6-month score-history line chart trending up, recommendations with point-impact indicators, and a peer comparison. Depends on FEAT-001 (trustCategories, scoreHistory, recommendations, CircularGauge, AnimatedCounter).
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001's findings first. Rebuild app/trust-score/page.tsx as the server wrapper (metadata + <AppShell>) and move the animated ring/chart into app/trust-score/TrustScoreClient.tsx ('use client').
Add a large score display 87/100 with an animated ring chart (CircularGauge / AnimatedCounter) using colored segments for the category breakdowns.

Add the category breakdown rows from mock trustCategories, each with its score and the spec note: Network Security 92/100 (all devices updated, firewall active); Phishing Protection 85/100 (3 attempts blocked this month, 1 near-miss); Device Health 88/100 (12 devices connected, all recognized, 1 needs firmware update); Privacy Posture 90/100 (all controls configured, data minimization active); Family Safety 80/100 (teen account needs updated safe-browsing settings). Use ProgressBar for each.
Add a Score History line chart (hand-rolled SVG, no chart library) of the Trust Score over the past 6 months showing an upward trend, from mock scoreHistory.
Add Recommendations: action items to improve the score, each with an 'impact' indicator showing how many points it would add, from mock recommendations.
Add a Comparison line: 'Your household is safer than 78% of TrustShield users in your area'.
Run 'npm run build' and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: A large animated ring shows 87/100 with colored category segments.
Five categories render with their exact scores (92/85/88/90/80) and notes.
A 6-month history line chart shows an upward trend and recommendations show point-impact values.
The 'safer than 78% of users in your area' comparison is present.
verification: Run 'npm run build'; confirm exit 0 with no errors.

Run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:3000/trust-score, confirm the ring animates to 87, the five categories and their notes render, the history chart trends up, recommendations show point impact, and the comparison line shows; no console errors.
findings:
DONE. Rebuilt app/trust-score as a server wrapper (metadata + <AppShell> + PageHeader) delegating interactivity to app/trust-score/TrustScoreClient.tsx ('use client').

LAYOUT (top->bottom): (1) Headline ring — CircularGauge in segments mode (size 200, strokeWidth 16, hideCenter) drawing one colored arc per category, weighted by each category's share of the total score; an AnimatedCounter(value=87, startOnView=false) overlaid in the center counts up to 87 with a '/100' suffix and the 'Protected' label (trustScoreLabel from mock). '+4 pts this month' from trustScore.change. (2) Category breakdown — the five mock trustCategories rendered as ProgressBar rows, each with a color dot + score/100 + its note. (3) Score history — hand-rolled inline SVG line chart (ScoreHistoryChart), no chart lib: fixed 520x220 viewBox, y-axis auto-scaled to min-6..max+4 so the upward trend reads clearly, gridlines, a teal gradient area fill, data-point dots with value labels, month labels (Aug..Jan), and a stroke-dash reveal animation (measures getTotalLength in useEffect, animates strokeDashoffset to 0; requestAnimationFrame cleaned up on unmount). (4) Recommendations — the four mock recommendations, each with an emerald '+N pts' point-impact badge (ArrowUpRight icon). (5) Peer comparison Card: 'Your household is safer than 78% of TrustShield users in your area.' SAFER_THAN_PERCENT constant = 78.

DATA NOTE: Updated data/mock.ts trustCategories[].note values to the EXACT FEAT-007 spec notes (Network Security 'All devices updated, firewall active.'; Phishing Protection '3 attempts blocked this month, 1 near-miss.'; Device Health '12 devices connected, all recognized, 1 needs firmware update.'; Privacy Posture 'All controls configured, data minimization active.'; Family Safety 'Teen account needs updated safe-browsing settings.'). Scores unchanged (92/85/88/90/80). The older TrustScoreSnapshot.factors summaries in mock are untouched and no longer rendered by this screen.

PRIMITIVE CHANGE: Extended components/ProgressBar.tsx with an optional `barColor` prop (inline CSS color) so each category bar can match its ring-segment color without adding palette tokens. Existing callers (deepfake-checker, family-protection) unaffected — they still use `barClassName`.

CATEGORY COLOR MAP (ring segments + bars + dots), keyed by mock ids: tc-network #2dd4bf (teal), tc-phishing #f59e0b (amber), tc-device #34d399 (emerald), tc-privacy #38bdf8 (sky), tc-family #a78bfa (violet).

VERIFICATION: `npm run build` exits 0 (all 10 routes compile, no TS/ESLint errors; /trust-score = 4.55 kB). Node is NOT on shell PATH — prefix with `$env:Path = "$env:ProgramFiles\nodejs;$env:Path"`. `npm run dev` confirmed: GET /trust-score -> 200 and the rendered HTML contains the ring '87', 'Protected', all five category notes, the 'Score history' chart with 'Jan' axis label, the recommendations with point-impact badges, and the 'safer than 78%' comparison. (When probing dev, kill stray `node` processes first and pass an explicit `-p <port>` — a leftover dev server on 3000 caused false 404/500 before cleanup.)
